semantic.note: ReportLab Paragraph markup requires & < > escaping. Contract text frequently contains these chars. xe() helper added to generate_legal_pdf.py.
legal-review launches 5 subagents simultaneously: clauses(20%), risks(25%), compliance(20%), terms(15%), recommendations(20%). circuit_breaker.max_subagent_depth must be >= 5.
1-3 Low (🟢), 4-6 Medium (🟡), 7-10 High (🔴). Used consistently across legal-risks, legal-review, legal-batch.
CONTRACT-REVIEW-[name]-[date].md, RISK-ANALYSIS-[date].md, NDA-[parties]-[date].md, etc. Never deviate — PDF extractor regex depends on this.
legal-compliance covers GDPR/CCPA/ADA/PCI. Missing: CAN-SPAM, SOC2, HIPAA. Flag for next mutation epoch.
Every output MUST include: This analysis is AI-generated and does not constitute legal advice. Non-negotiable per CLAUDE.md Rule 1.
